name: facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/scripts/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.undistort_image: undistort a raw Aria camera frame using fisheye624 calibration to linear or spherical output
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.process_frame: process an Aria frame by undistorting the image and saving it to an output folder with metadata
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.interpolate_aria_pose: interpolate a closed-loop trajectory pose at a given capture timestamp using bisection search
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.read_frames_from_metadata: read and parse frame metadata from a transforms JSON file into a list of AriaFrame objects
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.storePly: store 3D point cloud data with xyz coordinates, normals, and rgb colors to a PLY file

facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.run_downloader_all: run the python downloader script to download all sequences and data types from a CDN file
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.run_downloader_specific_sequences: run the python downloader script to download specific sequences by name from a CDN file
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.run_downloader_specific_data_types: run the python downloader script to download specific data types by index from a CDN file
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.run_downloader_overwrite: run the python downloader script with overwrite flag to redownload previously downloaded sequences
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.review_parse_args: review the python parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for CDN file, output folder, and data types

facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.extract_aria_vrs_frames: extract Aria VRS frames with camera poses and calibration into JSON format using the CLI
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.run_single_sequence: run a single Aria VRS recording extraction with trajectory and semi-dense point cloud inputs
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.to_aria_image_frame: convert raw Aria VRS sensor data into structured image frames with rolling shutter timestamps
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.create_visible_depth_map: create sparse depth maps for SLAM camera frames using semi-dense point cloud observations
facebookresearch_egocentricsplats/script.fetch_visible_depth_map_for_RGB: fetch and project sparse depth points from SLAM cameras into the RGB camera frustum
